characterizations.result_summary: Only one single Tg at 123.5°C was detected in the DSC curve of terpolymer SMIA, indicating the copolymer structure is relatively homogeneous.

evidence.source_sentence: To verify there is no homopolymerization for St, the DSC curves were recorded. As displayed in Figure 2, only one single Tg appeared at 123.5°C in the DSC curves of the terpolymer SMIA, and the results agree with the empirical formula proposed by Fox et al. [20] which indicated that the structure of copolymer SMIA is relatively homogeneous.

evidence.source_sentence: As for SMIA, a one-step degradation process was observed from $3 5 0 ^ { \circ } \mathrm { C }$to $4 5 0 ^ { \circ } \mathrm { C } .$. The TGA curves of blends were similar to PVC, exhibiting a typical dehydrochlorination and carbon chain-breaking degradation process. When ABS (10 phr) was added to PVC, T and $\mathrm { T } _ { 5 0 }$increased from $2 6 1 ^ { \circ } \mathrm { C }$and 304°C to $2 7 3 ^ { \circ } \mathrm { C }$and $3 2 8 ^ { \circ } \mathrm { C }$respectively. Importantly, $\mathrm { T _ { i } }$and $\mathrm { T } _ { 5 0 }$increased to $2 8 0 ^ { \circ } \mathrm { C }$and $4 0 8 ^ { \circ } \mathrm { C }$with the addition of SMIA.
